fields.name: Requests
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x34FF630 (size 0x50, all zero). bg3.exe+0x34FA630 (equipment system, processing of EquipmentSystem.Equipment at system+0x10, stride 0x110) creates the component on a new entity when requests could not be executed this frame and fills +0x0: allocates size*0x110 bytes, copies 8 bytes (EntityHandle) and then the 0x108-byte rest of every element with bg3.exe+0x34F5E70 - Script Extender's esv::inventory::EquipmentRequest {EntityHandle InventoryContainer; std::variant<EquipRequest, UnequipRequest> Action} (Components/Inventory.h, 0x110 bytes). The same function reads the component back on the next frame (stride 0x50, query bg3.exe+0x3501A70). The element is redeclared here (the variant as an opaque block plus its index byte) instead of naming the SE type.

fields.name: SlotItems
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x34FA630 copies a 64-byte hash map into +0x10 (bg3.exe+0x1008810 for the key set with 8-byte keys, then values at +0x40 allocated as size*0x40). Every value is itself a hash map: its key set is copied by bg3.exe+0xF13E80 (keys are single bytes) and its values in a loop with stride 8. Reading side in the same function: the outer key goes to eoc::inventory::GetInventory as the owner entity, the inner byte key is passed as the slot to eoc::equipment::GetEquipmentEntityInSlot, the inner 8-byte value is checked with IsEntityAlive and compared with the entity found in the slot. So: owner -> (equipment slot -> item expected there). ItemSlot is 1 byte. The inner key is written as uint8_t (SE enum ItemSlot, underlying uint8_t).

open_questions: Never alive in the captures. The name SlotItems is descriptive.
Whether the inner byte key is exactly ItemSlot or another 1-byte slot numbering was not checked; the width is.

fields.name: InventoryContainer
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x34FA630 copies 8 bytes (an EntityHandle) first for every 0x110-byte element; SE esv::inventory::EquipmentRequest.InventoryContainer (Components/Inventory.h)

fields.name: Action
fields.evidence: Storage of std::variant<EquipRequest, UnequipRequest> (SE EquipmentRequest.Action), opaque because std::variant blocks the build. bg3.exe+0x34F5E70 (element copy used by bg3.exe+0x34FA630) switches on the index byte at variant +0x100: index 0 copies 24 bytes (SE EquipRequest: EntityHandle Item, bool CheckActionResourceCosts, ItemSlot Slot, bools, EquipSettings), index 1 copies the 0x100-byte UnequipRequest (Item, optional Inventory, optional Slot, flags, Type, optional InventoryOwner, optional Position, optional Level, optional DropMovement via bg3.exe+0x2E1D800, ShapeshiftState Guid at +0xE8, Settings, field_FF).

fields.name: ActionIndex
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x34F5E70 (element copy used by bg3.exe+0x34FA630): the variant's index byte (0 = EquipRequest, 1 = UnequipRequest) at element +0x108

second_pass: The element stride 0x110 and its variant (index byte at element +0x108, Equip 24 bytes / Unequip 0x100 bytes) are settled by bg3.exe+0x34F5E70; the 0x50-byte component (array + nested hash map) by the creator bg3.exe+0x34FF630 and bg3.exe+0x34FA630. External type replaced by a local struct with an opaque variant block.
